Care context

Fictional configuration for demonstrating the clinician view.

Asthma tracker

Daily wellbeing, symptoms, school absence, rescue use, and Bluetooth spirometry. Questions are resolved from the tracker definition.

Medication schedule

Demo controller A: one scheduled dose each morning and evening. Demo rescue B: as needed; no adherence percentage is calculated for rescue medication.

Action plan

Recorded green, yellow, or red status is displayed without generating new clinical instructions. A real implementation must use the patient's clinician-approved plan and expiration date.

Record boundaries

Read-only view. No real patients, live devices, Epic connection, or medical-record writes. No data leaves this page when changing filters.
